messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "reduction depends on therapeutic response"
set: ["reduction depends on therapeutic response", "dose depends on condition being treated", "dose depends on the fluticasone brand or strength used", "dose increases should be based on clinical response", "discontinue treatment after reduction", "doctor will adjust dose based on blood tests and response", "no dose reduction is needed", "additional weight reduction is clinically indicated", "doctor will determine right dose based on condition and response to treatment", "dose determined by doctor based on condition, age, and response to treatment", "increased to 10 mg three times a day based on your response", "consider dose reduction when used with bupropion", "response to them may be reduced", "adjusted according to blood pressure response", "full therapeutic effect may take 5 weeks or longer for OCD", "reduce dosage after adequate response has been reached"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
